args.summary:
Model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (36 + 48 + 36 m, bearing centre-lines; 16 m deck, 15 m carriageway, one-way, 4 lanes, Highway Class I, JTG D60-2015).

Idealization: 2D spine-beam, line-elastic; structure system "continuous_on_piers" since pier column geometry was given (MR-05). Girder: single-cell cast_box, C50 prestressed concrete; section integrated to A = 8.417 m², I = 7.1876 m⁴ (MR-02); Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ = 26.0 kN/m³, w = 218.842 kN/m, m = 22.308 t/m (self-weight of main girders only, MR-07).

Supports/bearings (laminated elastomeric, 2 per line, Ge = 1.2 MPa manufacturer value overrides the code default, MR-00): Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 2 = PTFE sliding (longitudinal free, Kh = 0), Pier 1 = plain elastomeric fixed (longitudinal spring). Kv from JTG 3362-2018 8.7 (shape factor S and Ee = 5.4 Ge S²): e.g. 3.61e6 kN/m at the abutments, 8.97e6 kN/m at Pier 1, 8.08e6 kN/m at Pier 2. Piers modeled as elastic beam-columns fixed at the base, twin 1.6 m C40 columns merged into single members (A = 4.021 m², I = 0.6434 m⁴, Ec = 32500 MPa), heights 8 m (Pier 1) and 11 m (Pier 2) (MR-06).

Live load: 4 lanes (ξ = 0.67), qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 332/356/332 kN for spans 1–3 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1). Modal analysis gives f1 = 2.980 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.1772 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Results: vertical frequencies 2.980 / 4.761 / 5.479 Hz; self-weight reactions at abutments ≈ 2834/2843 kN and at piers ≈ 10302/10281 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 15.57/23.42/15.73 MN·m and support moments ≈ −39.76/−39.45 MN·m; lane-load max positive moment 14.36 MN·m, max negative moment −11.48 MN·m. Model passed L1/L2/L3 checks.
